source.title: PODCAST MREŽNICA - C.Macgregor: Trump u Iranu: Eskalacija vodi u još gore,  povlačenje u poniženje

summary.title_hr: PODCAST MREŽNICA - C.Macgregor: Trump u Iranu: Eskalacija vodi u još gore, povlačenje u poniženje
summary.abstract_hr: U ovoj epizodi Podcasta Mrežnica gost je Cameron Macgregor, američki komentator te geopolitički i ekonomski stručnjak, a razgovor se vodi na engleskom jeziku. Tema je rat Sjedinjenih Američkih Država i Izraela s Iranom. Gost tvrdi da u tom ratu nisu u pitanju američki nacionalni interesi, da Iran trenutačno pobjeđuje te da se predsjednik Donald Trump nalazi pred izborom između eskalacije i povlačenja, pri čemu nijedna opcija ne donosi pobjedu. Razgovara se i o mogućnosti trećeg svjetskog rata, globalnoj energetskoj i ekonomskoj krizi te kraju unipolarnog svijeta i dolarskog sustava. Gost smatra da Zapad prolazi kroz geopolitičko, ekonomsko i duhovno pročišćenje iz kojeg će nastati uravnoteženiji, multipolarni svijet. Na kraju govori o svojim posjetima Hrvatskoj.
key_topics: američka vanjska politika i predsjednik trump
multipolarni svijet i kraj dolarske dominacije
key_points: Macgregor tvrdi da je rat s Iranom posljedica Trumpova predizbornog obećanja AIPAC-u i drugim posebnim interesnim skupinama, a ne američkih nacionalnih interesa. Prema njegovu mišljenju, SAD nema jasnu strategiju osim nejasne ideje o promjeni režima.
Prema gostu, američko vodstvo očekivalo je rat od 48 do 72 sata, a najviše tjedan dana, jer je Iran smatralo slabim. Umjesto toga, Iran se desetljećima pripremao i, kako tvrdi, odlučno pobjeđuje.

Trump bira između eskalacije i povlačenja. Eskalacija bi, prema gostu, pogoršala stanje za SAD, regiju i svjetsko gospodarstvo te srušila njegovu administraciju, a povlačenje bi značilo političko poniženje i neutralizaciju Izraela kao regionalne sile.

Gost smatra da prosječni Amerikanci još nisu bijesni, ali ih brinu troškovi života i cijene goriva. Ako se rat nastavi tjednima i mjesecima, porast cijene nafte mogao bi gurnuti SAD u recesiju, a krivnja bi pala na Trumpa.

Prema gostu, treći svjetski rat još nije počeo, ali regionalni rat jest. Kina i Rusija podupiru Iran, no nastojat će izbjeći širenje sukoba, a svjetski se rat po njegovu mišljenju može izbjeći promjenom režima na Zapadu.

Gost predviđa globalnu energetsku krizu koja je već počela i vjerojatnu globalnu recesiju ili depresiju. Također predviđa kraj unipolarnog trenutka i dolarskog sustava, što smatra pozitivnim jer vodi prema uravnoteženijem svijetu.

Svoju tvrdnju o duhovnom ratu objašnjava krizom identiteta Zapada koji je postao arogantan, promiskuitan i materijalističan. Smatra da je potrebno duhovno buđenje i povratak moralnom kodeksu, što ne znači kraj zapadne civilizacije nego njezino preoblikovanje.
key_topics_en: american foreign policy and president trump
multipolar world and the end of dollar dominance
key_points_en: Macgregor claims that the war with Iran is a consequence of Trump's campaign promise to AIPAC and other special interest groups, and not of American national interests. In his view, the US has no clear strategy other than a vague idea of regime change.

According to the guest, the American leadership expected a war of 48 to 72 hours, and at most a week, because it considered Iran weak. Instead, Iran has been preparing for decades and, as he claims, is decisively winning.

Trump is choosing between escalation and withdrawal. Escalation would, according to the guest, worsen the situation for the US, the region, and the world economy and bring down his administration, while withdrawal would mean political humiliation and the neutralization of Israel as a regional power.

The guest believes that average Americans are not yet furious, but are worried about the cost of living and fuel prices. If the war continues for weeks and months, the rise in oil prices could push the US into a recession, and the blame would fall on Trump.

According to the guest, World War III has not yet begun, but a regional war has. China and Russia support Iran, but will seek to avoid widening the conflict, and a world war can in his opinion be avoided by regime change in the West.

The guest predicts a global energy crisis that has already begun and a probable global recession or depression. He also predicts the end of the unipolar moment and the dollar system, which he considers positive because it leads toward a more balanced world.

He explains his claim of a spiritual war through the crisis of identity of the West, which has become arrogant, promiscuous, and materialistic. He believes that a spiritual awakening and a return to a moral code are necessary, which does not mean the end of Western civilization, but its reshaping.
summary.title_en: PODCAST MREŽNICA - C.Macgregor: Trump in Iran: Escalation leads to worse, withdrawal to humiliation
summary.abstract_en: In this episode of Podcast Mrežnica, the guest is Cameron Macgregor, an American commentator and geopolitical and economic expert, and the conversation is conducted in English. The topic is the war of the United States of America and Israel with Iran. The guest claims that American national interests are not at stake in this war, that Iran is currently winning, and that President Donald Trump faces a choice between escalation and withdrawal, with neither option bringing victory. The possibility of World War III, the global energy and economic crisis, and the end of the unipolar world and the dollar system are also discussed. The guest believes that the West is going through a geopolitical, economic, and spiritual purification from which a more balanced, multipolar world will emerge. At the end, he speaks about his visits to Croatia.
